question: Which twelve-syllabled form of Viṣṇu is invoked for protection in the north?
premises: The protective power is identified as Viṣṇu.
This form is described as twelve-syllabled in nature.
It is asked to protect the speaker always in the north.
inference: The twelve-syllabled Viṣṇu protects in the north.
plain_english: May Viṣṇu, in his twelve-syllabled form, always protect me in the north.
